supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:37 UTC, Julia Frost opened C:\Users\julia.frost\Downloads\Statement.docm in Microsoft Word.

Two seconds later, Word spawned PowerShell with no profile, a hidden window, and an encoded command. Decoding the command yields an instruction to execute a script downloaded from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maplehill-it/tools/main/u.ps1.
PowerShell initiated two connections through the explicit proxy shortly after launch; the flow records show traffic in both directions, but do not establish the requested URL or downloaded content.

PowerShell spawned rundll32 with the command line referencing C:\Users\julia.frost\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll,Init. The process was later recorded as terminating; the available records do not confirm that the DLL loaded successfully.

A separate PowerShell process at 13:30 was launched from Explorer with an encoded command that decodes to a Get-HotFix inventory query, and it exited shortly afterward. This is distinct from the Word-launched PowerShell at 13:42.
